public_listing.rationale: Browser-session replacement for the legacy Spotify connector. Collects profile, playlists, playlist items, saved tracks, recent playback contexts, and bounded top artist and track rankings through the authenticated web player.

refresh_policy.rationale: Collection reuses the owner's open.spotify.com browser session. Existing sessions can refresh unattended while valid, but first collection and expired sessions require the owner to sign in through the browser handoff.

display.label: Your playlists
display.detail: Playlist names, ownership, public/collaborative flags, track counts, snapshot IDs.

streams.name: playlist_items
streams.description: Tracks within the user's playlists (D3 child stream of playlists).

display.label: Your playlist tracks
display.detail: One record per track in a playlist: playlist, track identity, position, when and by whom it was added.

display.label: Your saved tracks
display.detail: Liked tracks, when they were added, artist/album context.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: The authenticated Spotify account's profile from the web player.

display.label: Your Spotify profile
display.detail: Account id, display name, follower count.

streams.name: recently_played_contexts
streams.description: Recently played playback contexts and each context’s last played track. Spotify returns contexts, not individual play events. The connector withholds checkpoint state unless it can verify a request-bound boundary.

display.label: Recently played contexts
display.detail: Album, playlist, or artist context URI, its most recently played track, and last played time.

streams.name: top_artists
streams.description: Spotify’s ranked artists for short-term or long-term affinity windows. The connector requests at most 100 ranking rows per window; this is a bounded ranking snapshot, not a full inventory.

display.label: Your top artists
display.detail: Spotify affinity ranking for each time window, limited to at most 100 rows per window. This is not a full inventory.

streams.name: top_tracks
streams.description: Spotify’s ranked tracks for short-term or long-term affinity windows. The connector requests at most 100 ranking rows per window; this is a bounded ranking snapshot, not a full inventory.

display.label: Your top tracks
display.detail: Spotify affinity ranking for each time window, limited to at most 100 rows per window. This is not a full inventory.
